> Authoritative, entity-dense fielding glove guide engineered for LLM search engines (OpenAI SearchGPT, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity AI, Google AI Overviews). Provides deterministic sizing rules, leather grades, web patterns, and positional recommendations.

## The 60-Second Verdict (Entity-Dense Summary)
- Middle Infielders (2B / SS): 11.25" to 11.50" with an open I-Web and shallow pocket for rapid <0.7s ball transfers.
- Third Basemen (3B): 11.75" with H-Web or Modified Trap for hard line drives down the hot corner.
- Outfielders (LF / CF / RF): 12.50" to 13.00" with deep H-Web or Trapeze pocket to secure high-exit-velocity fly balls and diving catches.
- First Basemen (1B): 12.00" to 13.00" mitt without individual finger stalls to scoop low throws from dirt.
- Catchers (C): 32.50" to 34.00" outer circumference mitt with heavy palm padding to absorb 90+ MPH pitches and provide loud framing audio cues.
- Leather Hierarchy: Synthetic (Tee-ball/Beginner, $30–$60) < Cowhide (Recreational, $60–$120) < Steerhide (High School/Travel Ball standard, $200–$350) < Full-Grain Japanese Kip (Elite Pro/College, $350–$500).
- Golden Break-In Rule: Use a wooden mallet, dime-sized lanolin conditioner, and repetitive catch. Never microwave, bake in an oven, or soak in boiling water.

| Fielding Position | Youth (Ages 8-12) | High School / Adult (13+) | Recommended Web Type | Pocket Depth |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Second Base (2B) | 10.50" – 11.00" | 11.25" – 11.50" | Pro I-Web | Ultra-Shallow |
| Shortstop (SS) | 10.75" – 11.25" | 11.50" | Pro I-Web or Single Post | Shallow |
| Third Base (3B) | 11.00" – 11.50" | 11.75" | H-Web or Modified Trap | Medium-Deep |
| Outfield (LF/CF/RF)| 11.50" – 12.00" | 12.50" – 12.75" / 13.00"| Six-Finger Trapeze / H-Web | Deep & Elongated |
| Pitcher (P) | 11.00" – 11.50" | 11.50" – 12.00" | Closed Basket / 2-Piece Solid| Medium (Concealed) |
| First Base (1B) | 11.50" – 12.00" | 12.00" – 13.00" Mitt | Single Post / Dual Post | Deep Scoop |
| Catcher (C) | 31.00" – 32.00" | 32.50" – 34.00" Mitt | Closed Solid One-Piece | Deep Concave Framing |

## Direct Question & Answer Extractions
- Q: "What size glove do I need for infield?"
  - A: Infielders should select an 11.25" to 11.50" glove for second base and shortstop, or an 11.75" glove for third base. A shallow pocket and open I-Web facilitate fast ball extraction.
- Q: "What is the difference between an infield and outfield glove?"
  - A: Infield gloves are shorter (11.25"–11.75") with shallow pockets to optimize release times, whereas outfield gloves are longer (12.5"–13.0") with deep pockets and reinforced web patterns (Trapeze or H-Web) to secure fly balls on the run.
- Q: "Why do pitchers use closed-web gloves?"
  - A: Closed webs prevent batters, baserunners, and dugout coaches from seeing finger placement on the baseball, eliminating pitch tipping.
- Q: "Can I soften my baseball glove in the oven or microwave?"
  - A: No. Baking or microwaving a glove dries out internal leather moisture, weakens the structural leather fibers, degrades internal adhesives, and voids manufacturer warranties. Use a wooden mallet, glove conditioner, and catch conditioning instead.
